product_name: Infinix GT 30 5G+ (Cyber Blue, 8GB RAM, 256GB Storage) | Cyber Mecha Deisgn with LED Lights | 90FPS on BGMI | 1.5K 144Hz AMOLED Display | Segment's 1st Gaming Triggers | 64MP Sony Camera | Infinix AI
description: GAMING DESIGN: The GT 30 5G+ features the Cyber Mecha 2.0 design, blending geometric precision with bold style tailored for gamers. Customizable white LED lights on the back enhance the experience for scenarios like charging and music.It comes in 3 color variants: Cyber Blue, Pulse Green and Blade White- all accented by bright LED lights. GAMING TRIGGERS: GT Shoulder Triggers offer console-like input for mobile gaming, reducing screen clutter and enhancing control. They’re also customizable for quick access to other functions, boosting overall usability. 1.5K 144Hz AMOLED Display: The GT 30 5G+ features a 1.5K AMOLED display with 144 Hz refresh rate, 2160 Hz touch sampling, and 4500 nits peak brightness for ultra-smooth, vibrant visuals. It also includes 2304 Hz PWM dimming, Gorilla Glass 7i, and TÜV Rheinland certification for eye comfort. 90FPS BGMI GAMING: The GT 30 5G+ is certified by Krafton for 90 FPS gaming on BGMI, offering smoother visuals, faster touch response, and improved accuracy—ideal for competitive, fast-paced gameplay. 64MP Sony Dual Camera: The GT 30 5G+ comes with a 64MP Sony rear camera with 8MP Ultra-wide camera. It also offers 4K vidoe recording from both front and rear cameras.
